entries.zh-CN: 工作流支持迭代节点和循环：可以遍历数组，设置循环的退出条件，并查看每一轮的结果。
entries.en-US: Workflows support iteration nodes and loops: go through an array, set exit conditions, and see the result of each round.

entries.zh-CN: 工作流失败后会显示原因，并可以从失败处继续；失败的智能体节点可以自动重试。
entries.en-US: A failed workflow shows why and can resume from the failure; failed agent nodes can retry automatically.

entries.zh-CN: 新增变量聚合节点，智能体节点可以指定要用的 MCP。
entries.en-US: Added a variable aggregator node, and agent nodes can choose which MCP servers to use.

entries.zh-CN: 可以通过插件安装工作流；导入工作流时会预览它依赖的插件。
entries.en-US: Workflows can be installed as plugins, and importing a workflow previews the plugins it depends on.

entries.zh-CN: 支持扩展包，一次安装一组插件。
entries.en-US: Extension packs install a set of plugins together.

entries.zh-CN: 插件市场会定期自动同步，安装和更新时显示下载进度。
entries.en-US: The plugin marketplace syncs automatically, and installs and updates show download progress.

entries.zh-CN: 对话中可以查看会话用量和回复耗时，并在输入框设置思考强度。
entries.en-US: Chats show session usage and reply time, and the composer can set the thinking level.

entries.zh-CN: 文件浏览器可以新建、复制、移动和删除文件。
entries.en-US: The file explorer can create, copy, move, and delete files.

entries.zh-CN: 对话支持右键复制和粘贴；输入不支持的斜杠命令时会提示。
entries.en-US: Chats support right-click copy and paste, and warn about unsupported slash commands.

entries.zh-CN: 显示 MCP 的运行健康状态，连接异常时在对话中提示。
entries.en-US: MCP servers show their health, and chats point out connection problems.

entries.zh-CN: 设置的开发者选项里可以下载诊断日志。
entries.en-US: Developer options in settings can download diagnostic logs.

entries.zh-CN: 智能体长时间没有响应时会自动重试并显示提示。
entries.en-US: An agent that stops responding is retried automatically, with a notice.

entries.zh-CN: 很长的对话和工作流记录滚动更流畅，工作流画布拖动更顺滑。
entries.en-US: Long chats and workflow transcripts scroll more smoothly, and so does dragging the workflow canvas.

entries.zh-CN: 侧边栏按类型分组，可以按状态筛选工作流，悬停显示完整标题。
entries.en-US: The sidebar groups its rows, filters workflows by status, and shows full titles on hover.

entries.zh-CN: 修复从插件市场安装插件时应用崩溃的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed a crash when installing plugins from the marketplace.

entries.zh-CN: 修复一个插件源失败时整个插件市场无法刷新的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed one failing source preventing the whole plugin marketplace from refreshing.

entries.zh-CN: 修复重新打开对话后消息时间不正确的问题。
entries.en-US: Fixed message times being wrong after reopening a chat.

entries.zh-CN: 工作流中的智能体可以使用工作区之外的文件。
entries.en-US: Agents in workflows can use files outside the workspace.
